slice: W202 public nominal static Nested complete parts

claim.scope: Finite direct two-column Wide Nested complete-part read/write regression and pinned stock/runtime qualification; LC(Nullable(String)), BASIC Variant(String, UInt64), and direct String under two String profiles.
claim.review_limitation: Luna candidate and static review are correlated; root independently inspected owners, executed all bounded compiler/native gates, authenticated raw process/literal/file observations and seeded a production defect.

implementation.intent: Expose nominal static Nested through the existing recursive BinaryBulk owners without a synthetic JSON sibling or per-product serializers.
implementation.root_cause: The recursive kernel admitted specialized Nested, but the existing typed leaf-buffer Wide writer and narrow metadata/parser route did not expose a direct BinaryValue complete-part storage envelope.
implementation.reader: NestedBulkColumnReader.open(part_path, column_name, expected_type, limits, transport_limits); read_marks(first,count).
implementation.nominal_rule: Nested retains its declaration and owns outer sizes plus an implicit named Tuple; the UInt64 key roots all physical lanes at parent marks while field counts operate in the flattened element domain.
implementation.serde_rule: Delegate field serde, LC dictionary lifecycle and Variant physical-prefix handling to shared existing owners.
implementation.publication_rule: Validate static descriptor and bounds, encode before staging, inspect exact staged roster/checksums/grid/index/public readback, then exclusively publish. Existing destination remains untouched; failure cleans its own stage.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: public storage API and persisted layout
boundaries.rollback: Revert only this scoped atomic local commit; no push and no source/runtime mutation.
boundaries.strongest_failure: Shared encoder/decoder agree on a wrong LC occurrence schedule or Variant physical header; native literal SELECT in both directions discriminates it.
guards: Nominal root and bounded canonical declaration equality; same-shape Array(Tuple) substitution is rejected.
Existing illegal child/type/depth/node/element/byte guards; Dynamic/JSON subtrees rejected without a structure-site owner.
Parent mark grids and exact physical stream roster; BASIC UInt64 Variant mode prefix, not logical discriminators alone.
Full LC replay even for later and zero selected windows; validly compressed off-window size/index/mark corruption rejected.
Pre-existing destination and atomic cleanup; independent literals supplement checksum/shape validation.
boundaries.budget_scope: Each Nested codec call retains its cumulative recursive budget; transport bounds accumulate across Nested value lanes. Not a combined key/index/metadata or whole-part RSS limit.
boundaries.reader_integrity_scope: Quiescent-part assumption. PartStreamSource authenticates declared sizes and consumed compressed-frame checksums, not whole unselected data-file hashes. Descriptor/name and transport limits precede their owned materialization; semantic codec limits can reject after transport-bounded lane reads.
nonclaims: Every legal recursive product or every dictionary schedule.
Dynamic/JSON-containing Nested under the new direct public API, JSON-as-Dynamic-actual, or COMPACT Variant.
Noncanonical persisted declaration text, arbitrary schemas, flattened Nested siblings, Compact parts or legacy specialized layouts.
Automatic OfflineTable/catalog dispatch through this new reader.
No-I/O codec rejection, whole-part RSS bound or performance improvement.
Full repository suite, all types, complete MV/projections, repository-wide class decomposition or overall active goal completion.

verification.identity_algorithm: Sort regular files under src/spec; SHA256 of concatenated path + NUL + file SHA256 + newline.
